question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

ABC
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "Very common knowledge".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"ABC"** (as mentioned in the example) means something that is very basic or widely known by almost everyone. It refers to information or concepts that are easy to understand and commonly known. (सामान्य ज्ञान)

 
 
• **Example:** "The importance of eating healthy food is ABC for maintaining good health."
 
 
 
• **Option 2: "Very common knowledge"** captures the meaning of the idiom perfectly as it denotes something universally or widely understood. (बहुत सामान्य ज्ञान)
 
 
• **Example:** "It is very common knowledge that regular exercise is essential for a healthy lifestyle."
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Fair and honest **(न्यायपूर्ण और ईमानदार): Refers to someone who acts justly and truthfully.

 
 
• **Example:** "He is known to be fair and honest in all his business dealings."
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Complete failure **(पूरी तरह से असफलता): Refers to something that fails entirely or is unsuccessful.
 
 
• **Example:** "The new policy was a complete failure as it did not achieve its goals."
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To be ready** (तैयार होना): Refers to being prepared for something.
 
 
• **Example:** "We need to be ready for any challenges that may come our way.
